thread:
mia.marketing: Quick check-in 1 final QA for launch blog copy + benchmark language. Need approvals on hero headline, benchmark caveat, and HubSpot mapping. Target publish Thu 11am PT. Doc: https://docs.google.com/launch-v3

luke.writer: Posted a pared-down hero: "Predictable LLM inference for production apps" with a subhead calling out latency and cost improvements. Left two variants in the doc.

jade.product: Prefer headline variant B that mentions "predictable economics". For the benchmarks section, include 'up to 3x lower latency' and 'around 40% lower per-token cost' with a short caveat. I'll attach the CSV.

sara.legal: Use the phrase "up to" and add the methodology link. Also: registration text needs explicit opt-in checkbox copy: "I opt in to receive product updates and webinar invites."

luke.writer: Added the caveat and the opt-in copy. Also added the appendix link: https://internal.redwood/benchmarks/launch-v3.

carlos.analytics: For tracking, we'll add GTM event 'launch_blog_cta' and pass campaign=launch_q3 via UTM. Map form to HubSpot list 'Launch Blog - Webinar' and tag leads with ['source:blog','campaign:launch_q3'].

mia.marketing: Confirming mapping then: formId 'hs_launch_q3', fields ['email','company','role'], list 'Launch Blog - Webinar', tags ['source:blog','campaign:launch_q3']. Anyone object?

sara.legal: Looks good. Ensure we do not add users to sales sequences without explicit opt-in.

jade.product: Approved on numbers and messaging; legal caveat added looks good to me.

luke.writer: Final copy freeze set in the doc. I'll clean up microcopy and slug suggestion: /blog/announcing-unified-inference.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule publish jobs >=48 hours before target. Use /schedule-publish and include rollback steps in ops runbook.

mia.marketing: Great. I'll pick hero variant B, finalize the doc by 5pm PT, and if no blockers will schedule publish tomorrow morning. Drop any last comments in doc. :rocket:
